name: steve
description: Multi-expert product design, script mode (no driver): Steve states the core value, four designers (UX / UI / backend / algorithm) work in parallel, PM unifies the plan, QA writes the acceptance criteria, then all seven vote -- unanimous agreement is enforced by the engine (converge=all_agree); a dissent sends the plan back to PM for revision; the final executable plan is written to docs/sop/steve_<slug>.md

actions.message:
Topic: {{topic}}

Read the upstream research first if it exists (try docs/sop/avenger_*.md via design_turn file_requests, one call). Then produce the brief, at most 12 lines:
1. The ONE sentence of core user value (the sentence every later design decision is judged against)
2. Scope: what is in the first shippable version, and the explicit non-goals
3. The 3-5 questions the four designers must answer
Call design_turn(kind="brief", text=...).
